_comment: What takes the edge off a blizzard's cold -- genuinely hot things, never merely bright ones.
A torch lights your ground and keeps the snow off it (that is vanilla's own rule, and `driftAt`
keeps it); it does not warm you, because a field of torches is a lit field you are still standing
in the wind of. A fire does, and never enough to replace cover.
A tag so a pack can add its own hearth. Minecraft has no heat model, so this is the smallest one
there is: a set of blocks and a radius.
